Ambiguity & Clarification Papers

RAC, ICR, Qulac/ClariQ/ClariT, CLARITY - Retrieval-grounded clarification, iterative clarify-rewrite loops, multi-facet ambiguity

## Paper Summaries ### RAC: Retrieval-Augmented Clarification | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | RAC: Retrieval-Augmented Clarification for Faithful Conversational Search | | **Authors** | Multiple | | **Venue** | arXiv:2601.11722 (2026) | | **Key Innovation** | Ground clarifications IN THE CORPUS, not LLM hallucination | **Key Claims**: - **Problem**: Prior work focuses on fluency/alignment, not grounding clarifications in corpus - **Solution**: Retrieve top-k passages → LLM generates clarifying question grounded in retrieved facets - **Mechanism**: Implicit facet extraction via supplying top-k passages to LLM - **Evaluation**: Qulac, ClariQ, PaQa, CambigNQ — faithfulness to retrieved content **Key Insight**: "Facet extraction is performed implicitly by supplying the top-k retrieved passages to the LLM, which then generates the clarifying question." **Relevance to Our Fix**: - Our `is_scattered_ambiguous()` detects vague queries → triggers clarify - RAC shows: **clarifications should be grounded in retrieved passages**, not just LLM-generated - Future: Use retrieved facets to generate clarification pills --- ### ICR: Iterative Clarification and Rewriting | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | ICR: Iterative Clarification and Rewriting for Conversational Search | | **Authors** | Sifei Meng, Dmitry Ilvovsky | | **Venue** | EMNLP 2025 | | **Code** | https://github.com/mengsifei/MultiturnRAG | **Key Claims**: - **Problem**: CQR ignores feedback from retrieval/generation - **Solution**: Iterative loop: `clarify → rewrite → retrieve → repeat` - **Loop**: `c_i ∼ M(r_{i-1})`, `r_i ∼ M(c_i, H, r_{i-1})` - **Results**: 0.5453 nDCG@5 on Task A (Rank 3/38) **Algorithm**: ``` for e = 1 to I: c_i ∼ M(r_{i-1}) # Generate clarification r_i ∼ M(c_i, H, r_{i-1}) # Rewrite with clarification if retrieval_confident(r_i): break return r_i ``` **Relevance to Our Fix**: - Our T5 = single-shot clarify (no iteration) - ICR shows: **iterative clarify-rewrite** improves retrieval confidence - Future: Add iteration for complex ambiguous queries --- ### Qulac / ClariQ / ClariT Datasets | Dataset | Source | Size | Focus | |---------|--------|------|-------| | **Qulac** | Aliannejadi et al. 2019 | 10,277 single-turn | Faceted ambiguous queries from TREC Web Track | | **ClariQ** | Aliannejadi et al. 2020 | Extended Qulac | Crowdsourced clarifications + answers | | **ClariT** | Feng et al. 2023 | 108k multi-turn | Task-oriented clarification with user profiles | **Key Stats**: - Qulac: 198 topics, 762 facets, 10,277 query-facet-question triplets - ClariQ: Extended with new topics, crowdsourced - ClariT: 108k multi-turn conversations with user profiles **Relevance**: Our 6 scattered queries map to Qulac/ClariQ patterns: - `وضعیت اعتباری چطور است` → faceted (cheque vs facilities vs general) - `بدهکار شدم چیکار کنم` → underspecified intent --- ### CLARITY: Multi-Facet Ambiguity in NL2SQL | Field | Detail | |-------|--------| | **Title** | CLARITY: A Framework for Conversational Language Ambiguity and Unanswerability in Interactive NL2SQL Systems | | **Venue** | ACL 2026 | | **Key Innovation** | Multi-facet ambiguity + unanswerability with grounded continuations | **Key Claims**: - **Multi-facet ambiguity**: Query contains multiple interacting ambiguity sources - **Framework**: Constraint-driven pipeline generating ambiguous NL2SQL with grounded continuations - **User behaviors**: Models partially helpful/unhelpful responses **Relevance**: Our clarify pills = single-facet; CLARITY shows **multi-facet ambiguity** needs multi-turn resolution. --- ## Clarification Approaches Comparison | Approach | Paper | Mechanism | Iterative? | Grounded? | |----------|-------|-----------|------------|-----------| | **Our T5** | — | Keyword-based scattered detection | No | No (static pills) | | **RAC** | arXiv:2601.11722 | Retrieve → LLM generates clarification from passages | No | **Yes** (corpus-grounded) | | **ICR** | EMNLP 2025 | Clarify → Rewrite → Retrieve loop | **Yes** | Implicit (via rewrite) | | **Qulac/ClariQ** | ACL 2019/2020 | Facet annotations for ambiguous queries | No | Facet-based | | **CLARITY** | ACL 2026 | Multi-facet ambiguity + grounded continuations | Yes (multi-turn) | **Yes** | --- ## Our Implementation vs State-of-the-Art | Aspect | Our T5 | RAC | ICR | Gap | |--------|--------|-----|-----|-----| | **Detection** | Keyword-based | Implicit (retrieve first) | Implicit (via rewrite) | Detection could be learned | | **Clarification** | Static pills (4 subspaces) | LLM-generated from passages | Iterative clarify-rewrite | Static vs dynamic | | **Grounding** | None (predefined) | **Corpus-grounded** | Implicit via rewrite | **Major gap** | | **Iteration** | Single-shot | Single-shot | **Multi-iteration** | No iteration | | **Feedback** | None | Retrieval confidence | Retrieval + generation | No feedback loop | --- ## Future: Iterative Clarify-Rewrite Loop Based on ICR + RAC: ```python async def iterative_clarify_rewrite(query, history, max_iter=3): rewritten = query for i in range(max_iter): # 1. Retrieve with current rewrite results = await retrieve(rewritten, top_k=10) # 2. Generate clarification grounded in results clarification = await generate_clarification_grounded( rewritten, results, history ) # 3. Get user response (or simulate) user_response = await get_user_input(clarification) # 4. Rewrite with clarification rewritten = await rewrite_query(user_response, history, rewritten) # 5. Check retrieval confidence if await is_retrieval_confident(rewritten): break return rewritten ``` --- ## Architecture: Clarification Flow ```mermaid flowchart TD A[User Query] --> B[Scattered Detector] B -->|Ambiguous| C[Retrieve Top-K Passages] C --> D[RAC: Generate Clarification from Passages] D --> E[Show Pills to User] E --> F[User Selects/Types] F --> G[ICR: Rewrite Query with Clarification] G --> H[Retrieve with Rewritten Query] H --> I{Confident?} I -->|No| C I -->|Yes| J[Generate Answer] style C fill:#dcfce7,stroke:#166534 style D fill:#fef3e0,stroke:#f57f17 ``` --- ## Related Pages - [Problem: Ambiguity Resolution](../problems/ambiguity-resolution.html) - [Paper: Retrieval Fusion & RRF](./retrieval-fusion.html) - [Paper: Sticky Context & Memory](./sticky-context.html) - [Architecture: RAC/ICR](../architectures.html#rac-icr)
